canonical_example.text: Los pájaros cantan en cualquier momento del día.
canonical_example.translation: Birds can sing at any time of day.

canonical_example.text: El gallo canta al despuntar el día.
canonical_example.translation: The rooster crows at the break of dawn.

canonical_example.text: La cantante se ha dedicado a recuperar cantes antiguos y aparecen varios en su último CD.
canonical_example.translation: The singer has devoted herself to bringing back old Andalusian folk songs and several are featured on her new CD.

canonical_example.text: Solo cantan los grillos macho.
canonical_example.translation: Only the male crickets chirp.

canonical_example.text: Cantó tras horas de interrogatorio.
canonical_example.translation: He confessed after hours of interrogation.

canonical_example.text: Te canta el aliento por las mañanas.
canonical_example.translation: Your breath stinks in the morning.

canonical_example.text: El Cantar de Roldán es un poema épico.
canonical_example.translation: The Song of Roland is an epic poem.
